tags.instructions: Use for changes since a known time, not a full order listing. Each item identifies an order and contains only changed properties; never clear an unchanged field merely because it is absent. One call returns the provider's unpaginated response. Timezone-less provider output is preserved explicitly as source date-time text, not silently interpreted as UTC.

functions.name: list-order-messages
functions.description: List all messages for one scheduled order, including internal visibility information when supplied.

orderId.description: Onlogist order UUID whose messages to list.

FunctionInput_onlogist_listordermessages.description: The scheduled Onlogist order whose messages to retrieve.

id.description: Onlogist message identifier when supplied; usable with the parent order ID for internal-message deletion.

text.description: Ordinary message text, without transport encoding.

creator.description: Provider display text identifying the creator.

orderId.description: Parent Onlogist order UUID.

internal.description: If present, whether the message is hidden from the service provider; omission means unspecified, not false.

senderType.description: Provider classification of the message sender.

createdSourceTime.description: Provider creation date-time text. Example values lack timezone, so this is not asserted to be a UTC instant.

items.description: One message with its parent order and provider-supplied visibility information.
Messages in the provider's returned order; no ordering guarantee or pagination is documented.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_listordermessage.description: The complete documented message collection for the requested order.

tags.instructions: Use with an order UUID to read its conversation and obtain message IDs for `delete-order-message`. Use `send-order-message` to post a message. One call returns the complete documented response, without pagination. Missing internal does not mean false; source time text may have no timezone.

functions.name: list-orders
functions.description: List one page of orders in a lifecycle status, ordered by ONLOGIST ID.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same customer and status; omit initially.

status.description: Lifecycle status to enumerate; omission uses IN_BUYNOW.

FunctionInput_onlogist_listorders.description: Select a lifecycle status and optionally continue its order listing.

displayId.description: Front-end ID rendered losslessly as text.

items.description: An order summary for UUID discovery.
One provider page, at most 100 orders, ordered by ID.

nextCursor.description: Next-page token, omitted when exhaustion is established.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_listorders.description: One status-filtered page of order summaries and its continuation.

tags.instructions: Discover UUIDs here. Defaults to IN_BUYNOW, not all orders. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same status. Use `get-order` for details or `batch-get-orders` for known UUIDs.

functions.name: list-qualifications
functions.description: List all qualification definitions configured for the calling customer.

FunctionInput_onlogist_listqualification.description: No input parameters are needed to list customer qualifications.

id.description: Opaque qualification ID, rendered losslessly from provider number.

type.description: Provider value type, such as YESNO; unknown strings preserved.

defaultValue.description: Configured default, including meaningful zero, when supplied.

items.description: A qualification definition configured for the calling customer.
All customer qualifications; empty if none configured.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_listqualificatio.description: The complete collection of customer qualification definitions.

tags.instructions: Use before `create-order` or `batch-create-orders`. IDs become keys in qualifications maps. Whole unpaginated collection is one page; provider type strings keep their original meaning.

functions.name: restore-order-before-update
functions.description: Revert previously applied scheduled changes in SCHEDULED_PENDING_REJECTED.

orderId.description: Order UUID whose rejected scheduled update should be reverted.

FunctionInput_onlogist_restoreorderbefor.description: Identifies the order whose rejected scheduled changes should be reverted.

orderId.description: Order UUID whose undo succeeded.

accepted.description: Provider reported successful reversion; inspect get-order for resulting values.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_restoreorderbefo.description: Acknowledges provider-reported reversion of the identified order.

tags.instructions: Check `get-order` first. Only use in SCHEDULED_PENDING_REJECTED. This reverts changes, not transportation. Use `update-order` to submit new edits.

functions.name: send-order-message
functions.description: Post a message to a scheduled order, either visible to the service provider or marked internal.

text.description: Ordinary Unicode message text; no pre-encoding is needed.

orderId.description: UUID of the scheduled order whose conversation receives the message.

visibility.description: serviceProvider sends with internal=false; internal sends with internal=true and hides the message from the service provider. No external recipient addresses are accepted.

FunctionInput_onlogist_sendordermessage.description: A message for a scheduled order with an explicit visibility choice.

orderId.description: Order UUID receiving the message.

accepted.description: Onlogist acknowledged posting the message; not evidence that anyone read or received a notification.

visibility.description: Visibility mode submitted with the message.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_sendordermessage.description: Provider acknowledgment of the submitted order message, not a delivery receipt.

tags.instructions: Use with a known order UUID. Choose visibility explicitly: serviceProvider posts to the order conversation; internal hides it from the service provider. Use `list-order-messages` to read the conversation or check an uncertain send. Success is provider acknowledgment, not recipient delivery. Do not blindly replay.

functions.name: update-order
functions.description: Modify an order in IN_BUYNOW, SCHEDULED, or SCHEDULED_PENDING_REJECTED, optionally adding a PDF. Price may only increase while placing.

price.description: Requested increased price, only while placing; overrides pricePolicy.

sendMails.description: Send status emails to this location.

message.description: Explanation accompanying the update; may add a provider-visible message.

carSerial.description: New VIN; empty requests blank text.

pickupTime.description: Return pickup instant with explicit offset.

sendMails.description: Send status emails to this location.

attachment.description: New PDF attachment, not a removal of existing documents.

contentBase64.description: Exact PDF bytes as standard base64.

pickupTime.description: New earliest pickup instant with explicit offset.

sendMails.description: Send status emails to this location.

orderNumber.description: New billing reference; empty requests blank text.

licencePlate.description: New plate; empty requests blank text.

handoverReportUrl.description: External handover URL; empty requests clearing if supported.

takeoverReportUrl.description: External takeover URL; empty requests clearing if supported.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted non-price fields remain unchanged. Null unsupported; empty text is explicit.

orderId.description: Order UUID to modify.

pricePolicy.description: When changes.price is absent, preserve current price or let the provider recalculate from the pricelist.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateorder.description: Order UUID, partial changes, and an explicit policy for omitted price.

orderId.description: Updated order UUID.

accepted.description: Provider accepted the update; scheduled changes may still require agreement.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateorder.description: Acknowledgment of the accepted order update, not final agreement.

tags.instructions: Use `get-order` for UUID/state. Scheduled changes may require agreement; use `restore-order-before-update` for rejected changes. Use `update-order-to-arrived` for arrival or reductions. Omitted price follows pricePolicy; new PDFs and messages may have additional effects on repeats.

functions.name: update-order-price-offer-to-accepted
functions.description: Accept a specific price offer for an order while supplying the observed offer price as a stale-price check.

orderId.description: Onlogist order UUID to which the price offer belongs.

priceOfferId.description: Onlogist price-offer ID obtained with the order's offer details, scoped to this order.

expectedPrice.description: Exact offered price observed by the caller, in the provider's monetary units; supplied to detect intervening price changes, not recalculated or currency-converted.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateorderpriceo.description: Order, scoped price offer, and observed price to submit for acceptance.

orderId.description: Order UUID used for acceptance.

accepted.description: Provider acknowledged acceptance; does not independently establish resulting order status, assignment, payment, or delivery.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateorderprice.description: Acknowledged acceptance of the specified order price offer.

tags.instructions: Use with the order UUID, price-offer ID, and currently observed offer price from the order details in Onlogist. expectedPrice is a genuine provider check, not a confirmation gate. If the price changed, review the current offer before accepting again. Use `update-order-price-offer-to-rejected` to decline instead. An uncertain acceptance must be checked before replay.

functions.name: update-order-price-offer-to-rejected
functions.description: Reject a price offer for an order and provide a rejection reason.

reason.description: Ordinary text explaining why the price offer is being rejected.

orderId.description: Onlogist order UUID to which the offer belongs.

priceOfferId.description: Onlogist price-offer identifier scoped to the supplied order.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateorderpriceo.description: The order, its price offer, and the ordinary-text rejection reason.

orderId.description: Order UUID used for the rejection.

rejected.description: Provider acknowledged the rejection; does not establish notification delivery or a resulting order status.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateorderprice.description: Acknowledgment of the rejection for the submitted order and price offer.

tags.instructions: Use with the order UUID and price-offer ID from the order's offer details in Onlogist, plus a reason. This changes the offer decision; reversal is not documented. Use `update-order-price-offer-to-accepted` to accept with its observed price instead. Check the offer state before repeating an uncertain rejection.

functions.name: update-order-to-approved
functions.description: Approve an order and all receipts for billing.

orderId.description: UUID of the order and receipts to approve.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateordertoappr.description: Order whose billing items should be approved.

orderId.description: Order UUID whose approval succeeded.

accepted.description: Approval accepted for order and receipts; not proof of payment.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateordertoapp.description: Acknowledgment of approval for the order and all its receipts.

tags.instructions: Inspect receipts with `get-order` first. This approves all receipts, not just transport price. Use `update-order-to-declined` to reject billing or `update-order-to-paid` after payment occurs.

functions.name: update-order-to-arrived
functions.description: Mark arrival, optionally initiating settlement with a reduced-price proposal.

orderId.description: Order UUID to mark arrived.

reduction.description: Optional settlement proposal; omit for arrival without reduction.

price.description: Provider monetary price value, provisionally the proposed final reduced price, not a percentage.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateordertoarri.description: Order arrival action with an optional reduction settlement proposal.

orderId.description: Order UUID whose arrival action succeeded.

settlementRequested.description: Reduction settlement requested, not final agreement.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateordertoarr.description: Accepted arrival action and whether reduction settlement was requested.

tags.instructions: Use UUID from `get-order`. Omit reduction for ordinary arrival. Reduction starts negotiation; final agreement has no API support here. Use `update-order` for eligible scheduling edits.

functions.name: update-order-to-declined
functions.description: Decline an order and all its receipts for billing with a reason.

reason.description: Explanation for declining order and all receipts.

orderId.description: Order UUID whose billing is declined.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateordertodecl.description: Order and explanation for declining billing for the order and all its receipts.

orderId.description: Order UUID whose decline succeeded.

accepted.description: Billing decline accepted; transportation is not cancelled.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateordertodec.description: Acknowledgment that the provider accepted the whole-order billing decline.

tags.instructions: Inspect order/receipts with `get-order`. This declines billing, not transportation. Use `cancel-order` for cancellation or `update-order-to-approved` for approval.

functions.name: update-order-to-paid
functions.description: Record an APPROVED order as paid without initiating a money transfer.

orderId.description: UUID of the APPROVED order to record paid.

FunctionInput_onlogist_updateordertopaid.description: The APPROVED order whose actual payment should be recorded.

orderId.description: Requested UUID.

requestAccepted.description: Provider returned aggregate OK, not independently observed final target state.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_updateordertopai.description: Request-level acceptance of the payment-state recording, without confirmation of final order state.

tags.instructions: Use after actual payment. Inspect with `get-order`; review and use `update-order-to-approved` first if appropriate. Use `batch-update-orders-to-paid` for up to 25.

functions.name: upload-handover-report
functions.description: Attach a PDF handover protocol to a scheduled order, optionally supplying structured mileage and takeover/handover data. Valid complete mileage data causes Onlogist to set the sub-status to DELIVERED.

orderId.description: UUID of a scheduled Onlogist order.

fileName.description: PDF filename for the multipart attachment; defaults locally to handover.pdf.

mileageData.description: Optional structured mileage data, serialized internally to the provider's JSON string. Complete valid data may set DELIVERED; absent members are not invented.

handoverAt.description: Handover instant with explicit offset, at whole-second precision.

mileageEnd.description: Ending odometer reading in the same native mileage unit as mileageStart.

takeoverAt.description: Takeover instant with explicit offset, at whole-second precision.

mileageStart.description: Starting odometer reading, in the provider's native mileage unit; kilometres are not established by the documentation.

licencePlateCountry.description: Provider licence-plate country code; these are Onlogist codes, not ISO substitutions.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of the exact PDF bytes; public limit 10 MiB decoded, provisional pending provider validation.

FunctionInput_onlogist_uploadhandoverrep.description: PDF handover report and optional structured mileage data for a scheduled Onlogist order.

orderId.description: Order UUID to which the report was submitted.

uploaded.description: Provider acknowledged adding the report. Does not independently establish DELIVERED sub-status or validity of every optional mileage field.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_uploadhandoverre.description: Acknowledgment that Onlogist accepted the handover report upload, without asserting an order status change.

tags.instructions: Use only for a scheduled order and a PDF document. Use `download-handover-report` to retrieve the document. Optional mileageData can affect the order lifecycle: Onlogist sets DELIVERED when all data is valid. Success acknowledges the upload, not necessarily that status change. Check the order before repeating an uncertain write.

functions.name: upload-takeover-report
functions.description: Upload a takeover PDF and optional structured plate, odometer and pickup-time data for a scheduled order.

data.description: Optional pickup metadata; absent properties not fabricated, null unsupported.

takenOverAt.description: Pickup instant with explicit UTC or numeric offset, retaining supported precision.

mileageStart.description: Starting odometer reading in undocumented provider mileage units.

licencePlateCountry.description: Provider plate-country code, not ISO alpha-2.

contentBase64.description: Exact PDF bytes in standard base64.

orderId.description: Scheduled order UUID receiving report.

FunctionInput_onlogist_uploadtakeoverrep.description: Takeover PDF and optional typed pickup metadata for a scheduled order.

orderId.description: Order UUID receiving report.

accepted.description: Report addition accepted; no delivered state inferred.

FunctionOutput_onlogist_uploadtakeoverre.description: Acknowledgment of the accepted takeover report upload.

tags.instructions: Use UUID from `get-order`; order must still be SCHEDULED. Supply original PDF base64 and typed metadata, not multipart or serialized JSON. Use `download-takeover-report` afterwards.
